visualCharacteristics: New: event cards in a 3-column wrapping grid on a grey band: image on top, large H3 event name, bold "Date:"/"Time:" label lines and optional description; no card chrome, no link or arrow, so not cards-linked-arrow.
contentPattern: Repeating look-alike event items in a wrapping 3-column grid; item count changes over time: Cards.

usage.description: Grid of event items (3 per row on desktop): image, event name heading, bold-label Date and Time lines, optional description. Not clickable.

reuseGuidance: Use for featured events or other dated items that do not link anywhere. Use cards-linked-arrow when each card links to a page. The grey band comes from section style (light-grey).
tableStructure: One row per event: cell 1 image (optional), cell 2 heading (H3 event name), then paragraphs starting with a bold label such as **Date:** and **Time:**, then an optional description
